title: Proxy & Gateway
content:
Photon is highly optimized for building API Gateways and Reverse Proxies. By leveraging fetch and zero-copy streaming, header transformation is nearly instant.

Bind a Reverse Proxy

When running behind Nginx or Cloudflare, ensure your app correctly interprets the original protocol and host by checking headers:

app.get('/verify', (c) => {
  const proto = c.req.header('x-forwarded-proto')
  return c.text(`Running on: ${proto}`)
})

Simple Proxy Implementation

You can easily proxy requests to another service using the built-in fetch:

app.all('/service-a/*', async (c) => {
  const url = new URL(c.req.url)
  const target = `https://internal-api.service.com${url.pathname}`
  
  return fetch(target, {
    method: c.req.method,
    headers: c.req.header(),
    body: c.req.raw.body,
    duplex: 'half' // Required for streaming bodies
  })
})

Advanced Note: Gravito's AOT router makes it 15% faster at path matching than Hono when acting as an API Gateway with complex routing rules.
